skill_evaluations.rationale: Core academic evidence retrieval, prior art discovery, and novelty validation already adapted and verified with live query fallbacks.
Dataset rights, provenance, license checks, checksum validation, and FAIR compliance fully integrated and operational.
Structured discovery-filter-read-archive algorithmic pattern adopted on demand. Background daemons, crons, and push mechanisms are strictly rejected per agent security policy.
Formula, core assumption, and empirical metric extraction heuristics incorporated into academic evidence evaluation without duplicating tool registry.
Multi-source citation and DOI cross-validation algorithm integrated under academic-evidence-search using Crossref and OpenAlex primary APIs.
Documenting summaries in Living Knowledge Vault markdown format adequately fulfills evidence retention needs without standalone card overhead.
Direct downloading of large binaries or paywalled PDFs violates hard invariants (fail-closed, no auto-download). Deferred in favor of lawful read_url_content and OpenAlex/arXiv text APIs.
Direct architectural collision with Living Knowledge Vault Checkpoints, experiment receipts, and Decision-Making governance. Strict rejection to prevent split-brain state.
Manuscript drafting belongs to REPORTS&DOCUMENTS phase, outside RESEARCH namespace boundary.
Academic prose refining belongs to REPORTS&DOCUMENTS phase.
Grant and research proposal formulation belongs to proposal workflows in REPORTS&DOCUMENTS.
Slide presentation generation handled by powerpoint MCP tools in REPORTS&DOCUMENTS.
Figure to slide rendering outside RESEARCH namespace.
Rebuttal and reviewer response management handled in AUDIT / REPORTS&DOCUMENTS.

conclusion: No upstream update required. Pinned commit 84880815 remains authoritative. All essential scholarly search and data gate functionalities are active via validated adapters.
